pre-market brief. Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

VERIFIED TAPE (from exchange OHLC data; authoritative, do not restate different prices):
| Ticker | Company | Cap | Screen | 1D close | 5D | Vol× 10d | Vol/gap event |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| ECO | Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. | Mid | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | -5.35% | -5.8% | 1.6× | both 2025-11-13 |
| SECZ | Securitize Corp. | Small | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | +6.53% | -11.3% | 0.6× | gapper 2026-09-24 |

TASK
Run a separate search for EACH ticker ("<company> stock news", "<company> shares <session date>").
Find why it moved on Thursday October 15, 2026, any after-hours / pre-market move on Friday October 16, 2026, and
other material news in the window. Search press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire),
SEC filings, FDA, Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily,
company IR pages, analyst-action roundups.
If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,
competitor, partner, sector report) and name that company and event.

OUTPUT (markdown; one section per ticker, in the order given; no intro or conclusion):

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or a concise sector name (Pharma, Energy, Retail, ...).
If you find nothing, write exactly one bullet: "- No company-specific catalyst found in window" and,
if applicable, a second bullet naming the sympathy driver.

Include when available: catalyst for the move, earnings figures, guidance, analyst actions, contracts
with $ size, filings, regulatory decisions, management quotes with numbers, next catalyst date.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. (ECO) `[Energy]`
- Shares opened at $89.67 after a prior close of $95.66 and were last reported at $92.5570 on October 15, with 400,568 shares traded; the report did not identify a new company-specific catalyst (The Cerbat Gem, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[1]
- B. Riley raised its price target from $75 to $100 and maintained a Buy rating on October 5; Zacks Research lowered its rating from Strong Buy to Hold on the same date (The Cerbat Gem, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[1]
- Okeanis last reported quarterly results on August 5: EPS was $5.91 versus a $4.61 consensus estimate, and revenue was $268.14 million versus a $220.28 million consensus estimate (The Cerbat Gem, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[1]
- A report published October 14 cited Reuters reporting that a tanker and a container ship were hit by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz; Iranian officials said new offensive tactics against ships had been used for about 10 days [report] (Finanztrends, Oct 14, 2026; publish time not stated).[6]
- No ECO-specific filing, earnings release, analyst action, or after-hours/pre-market catalyst was identified in the available results through 02:03 ET on October 16, 2026.

## Securitize Corp. (SECZ) `[Financial Technology]`
- Pomerantz announced an investigation into potential securities-fraud or other unlawful-business-practice claims involving Securitize and certain officers or directors at 10:00 ET on October 15 (Pomerantz LLP via PR Newswire, Oct 15, 2026, 10:00 ET).[2]
- Citi downgraded Securitize from Buy to Neutral and raised its price target to $14; the report said the stock was trading at $11.21 and was down about 10% for the year (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[3]
- Securitize hosted “The Future of Wall Street,” an October 15 New York event with speakers from ICE, BlackRock, and Cantor Fitzgerald focused on tokenization and capital markets (The Cryptocurrency Post, Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[7]
- Securitize completed tokenization of Ark Invest’s ARK Venture Fund, ARKVX, giving eligible investors blockchain-based exposure to the fund’s portfolio; Cathie Wood called the move a “natural extension” of Ark’s mission (AOL, Oct 15, 2026, 03:58 ET).[4]
- Securitize shares were reported down 2.56% after hours after closing at $10.55, down 5.72%, in coverage of the ARKVX tokenization announcement (AOL, Oct 15, 2026, 03:58 ET).[4]
- StoneX analyst Mark Palmer maintained a Buy rating and raised the price target from $12 to $18 on October 14; StoneX projected approximately $198.5 million of 2028 revenue and cited second-quarter trading volume of $5.3 billion (Gate News, Oct 14, 2026; updated Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[9]
- Securitize launched tokenized Apple, Nvidia, and Tesla shares on Solana on October 10, with trades settled in USDC; the report said most of the $5.3 billion second-quarter trading volume generated no transaction-fee revenue (Gate News, Oct 14, 2026; updated Oct 15, 2026; publish time not stated).[9]
